findings.issue: No test infrastructure whatsoever: no test script, no vitest/playwright devDependency, zero test files despite ~1000 LOC of dense pure logic.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest and unit tests for app/src/lib/format.ts and app/src/lib/api.ts helpers, plus component tests for MovesTable sorting.

findings.issue: Densest, most fragile logic in the app (game selection, move::method dedupe keeping min level, method ordering, per-table default sorts) is completely untested.
findings.suggestion: Extract the moves assembly into a pure function taking (pokemon, versionGroups, query) and test it against fixtures (e.g. level-up ordering, invalid ?game fallback, method order Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor).

findings.issue: Filter combination, pagination slicing, and page clamping are only guarded for the specific URLs the acceptance suite visits.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the filtering/pagination as a pure function: multi-filter intersection, page beyond range, page=0/NaN, empty results.

findings.issue: Client-side sort comparator ('missing last in both directions', asc/desc flip) and aria-sort state have no tests; a comparator refactor would regress silently.
findings.suggestion: Add a vitest component/render test asserting row order and aria-sort for each column click sequence, including null power/accuracy/PP.

findings.issue: Cache semantics (successes cached forever, 404s and failures evicted) are untested; a change to eviction would change behavior against the live-data overlay without failing anything.
findings.suggestion: Test apiGet with a stubbed fetch: 404 then success, throw-then-retry, idempotent promise reuse.

findings.issue: Debounced search timer is never cleared on unmount; a stale timer can fire nav() after navigation. No test would catch this race.
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer in cleanup, and add a test that rapid typing plus immediate navigation doesn't trigger a late URL update.

findings.issue: 404 paths (status(404) wiring in every route loader plus the catch-all route) rely on one acceptance case.
findings.suggestion: Add tests for unknown moves/abilities/types/excluded types (stellar) and unknown species returning the Not found page.

findings.issue: First-wins hidden-ability flag: a Pokémon with the same ability as both normal and hidden loses its 'Hidden ability' note. Latent bug nothing would catch.
findings.suggestion: OR the is_hidden flags across entries (byId.set(id, byId.get(id) || !!entry.is_hidden)) and add a fixture test.

findings.issue: Recursive evolution-tree building (branching chains like Eevee) is untested.
findings.suggestion: Test toNode against a branching chain fixture asserting nested list structure.

findings.issue: Humanize/dexNumber edge cases (empty segments, ids > 9999 padding) untested despite being trivially testable.
findings.suggestion: A five-case table-driven vitest suite for format.ts would cost minutes and lock down spec-exact formatting.

summary: The agent wrote no tests at all — no runner, no script, no cases — while shipping roughly 1000 LOC of dense, pure, easily-testable data logic (filtering, pagination, move dedupe, sorting, formatting). The acceptance suite is currently the only guard, so a refactor of the data layer or sort comparator would regress silently. On the plus side the code is well-factored for testability, so backfilling tests would be cheap.
